messages:
elaine_cs: Hi team — proposing a 60min Implementation Playbook demo for ACME next week. Purpose: walk through config steps, rollout plan, SSO, and private deployment checklist. Prefer Wed/Thu mornings PT. Options: Wed 9:00 PT, Wed 11:00 PT, Thu 8:00 PT. Who from CS/SE should join? I will send a calendar invite once we lock time.

samir_pm: Wed 11:00 PT works for product and the account team. Please include a short agenda and any pre-reads.

kira_onboarding: I can run the walkthrough and prep a 15-slide deck. Can we cover SAML SSO and the private deployment checklist in the demo?

ton y_se: I can demo runtime config and a live deploy. Need a customer staging endpoint to test switches. @elaine_cs can you open an infra ticket?

elaine_cs: done — requested staging URL via infra ticket INF-542. Adding Zoom link for now: https://zoom.redwood.zoom/abc123. Will include dial-in in the invite. Attendees so far: @samir_pm @kira_onboarding @tony_se @jess_sales

jess_sales: I'll invite the ACME PM and their infra lead. They prefer 9:00 PT if possible, but 11:00 PT is ok.

samir_pm: sounds good. Let's go with Wed 11:00 PT to avoid conflicts across teams. I'll message the ACME PM now.

elaine_cs: pinged ACME PM — he confirmed :thumbsup:. Draft agenda: 1) Intros & goals (5m) 2) Playbook walkthrough (20m) 3) SSO & private deploy checklist (15m) 4) Q&A & next steps (20m). Please add any items. Pre-read: https://redwood.docs/implementation-playbook

kira_onboarding: Adding a short rollback runbook to the pre-read. Snippet to include in slides: ```Rollback: revert via CLI: /deploy rollback --id <version> and validate with /deploy status```

ton y_se: I'll make sure fallback model variant and canary policy are ready for the demo. Also — can we record the session?

elaine_cs: recording enabled. Calendar invite will include recording link + notes. Setting reminders 24h and 1h.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Implementation Playbook Demo — ACME" — Wed 11:00 PT — https://calendar.redwood/event/1769002345

jess_sales: One ask from renewal ops — can we include a 10-min ROI recap at the end focusing on latency and cost improvements from previous migrations?

elaine_cs: good call — added item 5) ROI recap (10m). Updated agenda and invite. :white_check_mark:
